title: Adopting AI Technologies without Traps: A Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Framework
abstract: arXiv:2611.30200v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI technologies and AI agents play increasingly important roles in human society, including in education, economics, and research. Adopting AI technologies can bring immediate, and sometimes tremendous, rewards such as through productivity boost, but they can also bring negative effects including but not limited to losses of job and training opportunities, and cognitive capability declines. Thus, it is important to investigate the optimal ways of adopting AI technologies without different traps. In this paper, we develop a general multi-agent Markov decision process (MDP) based reinforcement learning (RL or MARL) modeling framework for determining and analyzing optimal adoption of AI technologies. This framework can model the long-term dynamic effects of AI adoption, and lead to finding the optimal AI adoption strategies. translated_title: 规避陷阱的AI技术采纳：一个多智能体强化学习框架
translated_abstract: AI技术和AI智能体在人类社会中扮演着日益重要的角色，涵盖教育、经济和研究等领域。采用AI技术可以带来即时、有时甚至巨大的回报，例如生产力提升，但也可能带来负面影响，包括但不限于就业和培训机会的丧失以及认知能力的下降。因此，研究如何以最优方式采用AI技术并避免各种陷阱十分重要。本文开发了一个基于多智能体马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）的通用强化学习（RL/MARL）建模框架，用于确定和分析AI技术的最优采用方式。该框架能够建模AI技术采纳的长期动态效应，并有助于找到最优的AI采用策略。在该建模框架中，AI技术采纳的负面影响通过不良状态转移或负面……（原文摘要在此处截断）进行建模。
tldr: 本文提出了一个基于多智能体马尔可夫决策过程的通用强化学习建模框架，能够刻画AI技术采纳的长期动态效应，并据此求解最优的AI技术采用策略。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a general multi-agent reinforcement learning framework based on Markov decision processes that models the long-term dynamic effects of AI adoption and derives optimal AI adoption strategies.
